items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: What a wonderful guy and what a tremendous player, really, wonderful.

ctx.x: What a wonderful guy and what a tremendous player, really, wonderful. And at one time I tried to play a place called El Chapultepec every year in Denver. It’s called the El Chapultepec, which is a grasshopper. And the guy who runs it is Jerry Krantz. No cover, no minimum, and he takes care of artists financially and every other way. And I said, “You know there’s a guy by the name of Alan Vizzutti, he’s just phenomenal.” He said, “Yeah I know.” I said, “Well you ought to bring him in.” He said, “Well you know,…
Nowadays people pay for it themselves.
